title: Town Hall 19: Everything New
style: stylized 3D cartoon mobile strategy game art, chunky playful proportions, vibrant saturated colors, warm sunlight, cinematic composition, highly detailed, sharp focus

scenes.narration: Town Hall 19 is finally here, and it changes how everyone attacks. Here's everything new in 60 seconds.
scenes.image: a colossal new fortress town hall glowing with golden and purple energy at the center of a fortified cartoon village, fireworks in the sky, epic low angle

scenes.narration: The biggest change is Squads: whole groups of troops you drop with a single tap, trained in the brand new Squad Barracks.
scenes.image: a large army charging together out of a big wooden barracks: muscular cartoon barbarians with blond hair, blond mustaches and swords running beside slim female archers with pink hair, green hoods and bows, dust clouds, dynamic action

scenes.narration: Squads unlock at Town Hall 8, with a new one every Town Hall, up to twelve at Town Hall 19. But only Town Hall 19 can level them up.
scenes.image: twelve colorful battle banners in a row on a grassy hill, each with a different cartoon troop emblem, a glowing number 19 shield in the middle, bright sky

scenes.narration: Your Town Hall becomes a weapon of your choice: a Barbarian, Archer or Wizard Hall that unleashes troops when it's attacked.
scenes.image: a cartoon fortress town hall bursting open with magical light as blue-robed wizards casting fireballs and barbarians leap out to defend it, explosive action

scenes.narration: Defenses get two new towers, the Spiky Tower and the Firecracker Tower, and Guardians move into their own Guardian Shrine.
scenes.image: a tall cartoon defense tower launching colorful firecracker rockets into the sky next to a spiked stone tower, sparks and fireworks everywhere, night sky

scenes.narration: Heroes climb higher too. The Barbarian King now maxes out at level 115.
scenes.image: a huge muscular cartoon barbarian king with a golden crown, orange mustache and a giant sword roaring heroically on top of a rocky hill, golden glow around him

scenes.narration: Plus new Magic Snacks, and a Star Bonus that now scales with your Town Hall level.
scenes.image: glowing magical cartoon treats, cakes and lollipops floating above a wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold coins and purple elixir, sparkles

scenes.narration: So, are you rushing to Town Hall 19, or staying where you are? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.image: a cheerful cartoon builder with a hammer and yellow hard hat standing in front of a giant upgraded town hall at golden sunset, confident pose
